proof: For $n=1$, assign the unique concept the empty sample; the no-clashing condition is vacuous. For $n\ge2$, assign $\{i\}$ its positive example $(i,1)$. This example is inconsistent with every other singleton, so the teacher is non-clashing and has width one. Width zero assigns the empty sample to every target and makes any two targets clash. Thus the value is zero for $n=1$ and one otherwise.
name: No-Clashing Teaching Dimension of Singletons
